record.what_it_does: PitchBook provides a RESTful API and scheduled data feeds that deliver its private and public capital markets database (companies, deals, investors, funds, people, LPs, service providers) into a customer's own systems.
record.auth_notes: The core Data API uses a static API key sent as `Authorization: PB-Token {API_KEY}` (not OAuth2, not a generic Bearer scheme). A separate official MCP gateway (mcp-proxy-external.pitchbook.com / premium.mcp.pitchbook.com) authenticates via OAuth login through Okta.
record.access_notes: The API is a standalone paid offering separate from a PitchBook platform subscription, requiring a signed contract with PitchBook's Direct Data team, purchase of a per-call API credit balance, and account-manager issuance of an API key/sandbox key. There is no self-serve signup form that immediately yields working credentials.
record.main_blocker: requires a paid standalone contract and Direct Data team approval to obtain an API key; no self-serve credentials
